heard: If Betelgeuse exploded today, it would cast shadows at night. The monster star suddenly began to fade rapidly in late 2019. It plunged from top 10 brightest down past top 20. Astronomers panicked because this supergiant swallows the orbit of Mars. Many feared its fatal blast was happening hundreds of years early. Hubble solved the mystery. The star had just belched huge dust. When it really detonates, Earth will stay completely unharmed. Until then, Orion keeps hiding the star that will cast shadows at night.
